video.title: AI欧腐《向主人求饶吧，小兔子/Beg for Your Master,Little Rabbit》
video.desc:
Artist Ronan wakes inside a dark romance as Silas's cruel stepbrother, who is also a rabbit hybrid. To return home, he must drive the young wolf's corruption to 100%. But behind Silas's harmless facade lies a possessive future Wolf King. Seven years after Ronan leaves, fate brings them together again with their roles reversed.
画家 Ronan 一觉醒来，穿进了一本黑暗向言情小说里，成了 Silas 那个恶毒的继兄——还是个兔子兽人。想要回家，他必须把这头小狼的黑化值推到 100%。
可在 Silas 人畜无害的外表之下，藏着的是一位占有欲极强的未来狼王。
Ronan 离开七年后，命运让两人再次相遇——这一次，强弱易位。
